title: TinyWin2 JSONL build event stream
description: One JSON object per line on stdout while `tinywin2 build --json-events` runs. Sequences are strictly increasing; the final line carries phase 'result'. Tool log output never mixes into stdout in this mode.

seq.description: Zero-based event order. The final result event uses -1 because it is emitted by the CLI after the engine finished.

planId.description: Ambient plan id while a plan step executes; null otherwise.

data.description: Free-form payload. Progress events carry data.progress (0-100); the final result event carries succeeded/outputFormat/workspacePath/outputPath/manifestPath/layerCount/failedStepId.
